content:
Ana Soto: Heads-up 10: were seeing a spike in churn risk for a 6-account slice after the Spring preview changed the auth flow. Need a short playbook to stem churn.
Liam O'Connor: Which accounts?
Ana Soto: List in the tracker: Orchard, HelixBio, Northbay, Zephyr, AltairX, Sienna. Most flagged due to failed webhooks and missing webhook docs.
Priya Patel: I pulled the cohort activity dashboard  quick stat: these 6 dropped average weekly active sessions from 4.2 -> 1.1 after the 2026-03-12 preview push.
Diego Ramirez: Webhook example in the docs got renamed. I can patch the doc and add backward-compat note.
Hannah Li: I'll craft an outbound 2-line email + 3-step troubleshooting checklist to send to the accounts today. Draft below: 

Hi [Name],
We noticed your app failed to receive some preview events since 3/12. Quick steps: 1) Confirm webhook URL (public reachable), 2) Check event auth header signature, 3) Inspect retries in the dashboard logs. Reply and we'll jump on a 15-min call.

Ravi Singh: Can we send the micro-NPS before and after the fix so we have signal? I can wire a short in-product prompt.
Ana Soto: Yes. Hannah, add micro-NPS (1-5) pre-fix and 48h post-fix.
Hannah Li: Will do. Micro-NPS will go out before EOD.
Priya Patel: Action owners proposal:
- Diego: doc patch + compat note (ETA 6h)
- Ravi: NPS wiring & cohort tile (ETA 12h)
- Hannah: outbound email + checklist + send (ETA 3h)
- Liam: reserve two 15-min slots tomorrow for on-call triage (09:30 & 15:30 PT)
- Ana: own account outreach and risk classification updates
- Sara: run pre-check list against each account (webhook endpoints, certs)

OpsBot: Reminder: add tasks to cohort board  follow-ups due in 24h.
Diego Ramirez: Patch started  will create a short code sample showing proper signature verification.
Ravi Singh: NPS prompt text suggestion: "On a scale 1-5, how confident are you that Redwood previews will integrate smoothly with your product?"
Hannah Li: Good. Keep it simple. Also will include a one-click "request 15-min help" link.
Liam O'Connor: I'll block the triage slots and add calendar invites. If any account accepts, prioritize them.
Sara Mitchell: Quick note: HelixBio has internal proxy that rewrites payloads; may need to recommend using our signed-query workaround.
Ana Soto: Thanks Sara. I'll include that in the outreach and flag HelixBio for escalation.
Priya Patel: Please update the cohort heatmap after first wave of outreach so we know if risk changes.
Diego Ramirez: Doc patch link: https://redwood-internal.docs/previews/webhooks-compat (draft). PTAL.
Hannah Li: Email template sent to the list  copying it into the tracker now.
Ravi Singh: NPS tile in dashboard is wired to the cohort filter  will publish a live view once first responses arrive.
Ana Soto: If we get 2+ accounts requesting help, let's escalate to a quick "preview support hour" and invite eng on-call.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed. I'll standby and loop on-call if calendar fills.
Priya Patel: Anything else?
Sara Mitchell: One ask: include example curl payload that demonstrates signature header. I'll add to the doc PR.
Diego Ramirez: Done.
OpsBot: Follow-up: status check scheduled in 24h.
Ana Soto: Thanks team  will post an update once outreach results come in.
